## rough agenda:
- links: https://gist.github.com/michaelneuder/ba32e608c75d48719a7ecba29ec3d64b
- unconditional: https://ethresear.ch/t/unconditional-inclusion-lists/18500
- spec overview: https://notes.ethereum.org/@mikeneuder/il-spec-overview

.

- short presentation:
  - execution spec: “block validity depends on IL satisfaction”
  - consensus spec: “block not accepted into view without valid list of txns for the IL”
  - engine api: “construct the inclusion list once at the beginning of your slot”
  - design considerations:
    - unconditional
      - extend block or only on when gas is available
      - how to choose size in block extension case
    - ToB vs anywhere in block
    - Summary included in slot n block or slot n+1 block
    - Gossip the txns along with the block or separately
- questions/interactive session
